answer: In this PoA design, each interaction contributes a decayed trust signal: reputation loses half its weight every fixed temporal half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, mutually corroborated honest service to retain influence. EigenTrust factorization and reciprocity-weighted transitivity suppress isolated endorsements; freshly spawned sybils therefore start with near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot cross consensus thresholds, even when coordinated through a velvet reef of fabricated links.
